Two-way radio, CCTV, personal computer, and alarm systems

Maintain emotional control and professionalism under stress; prolonged standing; strenuous walking and climbing of stairs, able to see and hear with or without reasonable accommodation, moderate lifting and carrying (up to 40 pounds).
